summary:
## 1. Customer Profile
The customer is a female, likely in her mid-to-late 20s or early 30s, given her age and family situation. She is a single parent with a three-year-old daughter, Vivian. She has moved to Finland from England and has been living in the country for approximately four months. She speaks English at home with her daughter and is not yet familiar with the Finnish language.

## 2. Reason for Visit
The customer came to the service today to inquire about daycare options for her three-year-old daughter. She is looking for a full-time daycare that can accommodate her work schedule and provide a suitable environment for her child's language development.

## 3. Topics Discussed
The conversation covered various topics related to daycare options in Espoo, including the different types of care available (municipal, private, family daycare, open playground, playgroups), the costs associated with each option, and the eligibility criteria for receiving financial assistance. The customer also asked about the age group system in Finnish preschools and how children are grouped together.

## 4. Guidance and Information Provided
The customer was provided with information about the different daycare options available in Espoo, including the English-speaking Pilke Play School in Tapiala. She was also informed about the costs associated with private daycare, which range from 50 to 361 euros per month, depending on the family's income and service voucher. The customer was advised to apply online through the City of Espoo's website (Espoo.fi) and to use the Eva online service to communicate with daycare centers and book attendance times. The customer was also informed about the municipal daycare system, which offers free or low-cost care to families with low incomes.

## 5. Referrals and Next Steps
The customer was referred to the Pilke Play School in Tapiala and advised to apply online through the City of Espoo's website. She was also informed about the Eva online service and encouraged to use it to communicate with daycare centers and book attendance times. The customer needs to apply for a spot at the Pilke Play School and, if successful, will need to come back to the service to work on the voucher application. The customer can also email the service to arrange a follow-up appointment.

## 6. Additional Observations
The customer appeared to be anxious about finding suitable daycare for her daughter and was grateful for the guidance and information provided. There were no apparent communication challenges, and the customer seemed to understand the information provided. The customer did not have any outstanding questions not fully resolved, and the visit seemed to be a productive and helpful experience for her.

extraction.Confidence_Notes: All fields extracted with reasonable confidence
